description: Defines an enumeration ProtocolMessageType for WebSocket protocol message types, including start/stop emitting events, messages, commands, live events, and JWT tokens, with associated streaming types.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageType
classes.description: Enumeration of WebSocket protocol message types with methods to retrieve identifiers, check if they start streaming, and get associated streaming types.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the protocol message type.

methods.name: isStartSending
methods.description: Checks if the message type indicates starting a stream.

methods.name: getStreamingTypeOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the associated StreamingType or throws NoSuchElementException if none exists.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the identifier string of the message type.
